parts.name: Label
parts.description: caller-supplied text, programmatically bound to the control via `for`/`aria-labelledby`

parts.name: Required indicator
parts.description: visible asterisk or text, decorative; semantics carried by `aria-required` on the control

parts.name: Helper text
parts.description: optional persistent guidance below the control

parts.name: Validation message
parts.description: error / warning / success, replaces helper text when active; `aria-live="polite"`

parts.name: Leading icon (optional)
parts.description: decorative or semantic hint (e.g., search magnifier)

patterns.note: focus-ring fade-in on focus, opacity transition on disabled, instant copy swap on validation reveal (no animated text)

requirements.title: Label association
requirements.body: every form control has a visible label programmatically bound via `for` or `aria-labelledby`; placeholder text is never a label

requirements.title: Error announcement
requirements.body: validation messages use `aria-live="polite"` or are referenced by `aria-describedby` on the control; messages identify the field and the fix

requirements.title: Required indication
requirements.body: not signaled by color alone; uses `aria-required="true"` or the `required` attribute; visible asterisk supplements but does not replace

requirements.title: Keyboard operability
requirements.body: all controls operable from keyboard with standard tab order; no keyboard trap; custom controls implement expected key behaviors

requirements.title: Focus visible
requirements.body: visible focus ring meets 3:1 contrast against background; never `outline: none` without a replacement indicator

requirements.title: Color independence
requirements.body: error / success / disabled state never signaled by color alone; pair color with icon, text, or pattern
